target_selection: The 40 concepts marked e1=true in target_pool_v1.json.
curation_note: Binary answers are fixed by this project-curated question bank, not generated by a model. Category and geographic predicates use the target manifest; finer predicates are operational labels curated for this benchmark and should be reviewed before a confirmatory run.
